title: Pose signatures for comparison, not replacement
plainLanguage: A pose signature is a compact description of a selected body region after normalizing scale and position. It helps find similar examples; it does not paste one body onto another.
purpose: Make the growing library actively useful when a new video is uploaded.

rules.statement: Build signatures from the selected region’s visible reviewed or draft points, normalized by an explicit scale and root.
Use a combination of normalized vectors, pairwise distances, joint angles, and projected-length ratios rather than one number.
Visibility mask and view information are part of the signature context; missing/hidden points are not silently filled.
Mirrored matching is explicit and opt-in, never silent.

implementation.currentSupport: Corpus Pane 0.2.2.4 builds view-aware regional pose signatures, distinguishes visible geometry from known hidden anatomy, reports requested-region coverage, and records hidden-versus-visible disagreements explicitly. Search ranks by a combined pose-shape and graded-view score instead of making exact view the first gate.
implementation.futureWork: Continue measuring retrieval quality as the reviewed mannequin library grows; do not turn signature similarity into automatic replacement.
